verdict.rationale: The closest evidence is alert grouping, which lets users triage, escalate and attach many related alerts to an incident as one unit. A public API with an OpenAPI spec, a Terraform provider, and an MCP server could also be scripted to act on many items, but none is documented as offering bulk operations. missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-action capability for incidents, follow-ups or other entities, documented batch API endpoints or MCP bulk tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.
